global_rules: Choose a real template or a named style preset before writing slides.
Use one main job per slide and keep body text within the template's text-box budget.
Every image, icon, and chart must explain the page claim.
Prefer native editable text, shapes, charts, and tables for PPTX output.
Keep HTML preview as an optional delivery route; do not call an HTML preview a native PPTX.
Render every slide and inspect a contact sheet before delivery.
